recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. There is no core follow-up for FHIR-16138; any future work on observation-specimenCode should happen in the FHIR Extension Pack and account for the FHIR-44334/FHIR-52988 deprecation guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-16138 was a Published FHIR-core Observation change request resolved Persuasive with Modification. It requested support for a code-only specimen representation, and the accepted approach was to add a specimenCode extension for cases where neither a Specimen resource nor a precoordinated Observation.code specimen type was wanted.
initial_application: Historical core commit 99532b4c0a pre-applied GF#16138 by adding a specimen-code/specimenCode Observation extension with CodeableConcept value and v2-0487 example binding. Core later contained a generated StructureDefinition-observation-specimenCode.xml, which was removed from R5 core source by dd468d4f17 along with other extensions when extension source ownership moved out of core.
additional_context: Current core source still includes active Observation and Specimen resources. Observation.specimen is a Reference to Specimen or Group, and Specimen.type is a CodeableConcept bound to the specimen type value set. The observation-specimenCode definition is present in /home/jmandel/work/fhir-extensions, not core, and later FHIR Extension Pack issues FHIR-44334 and FHIR-52988 retired/deprecated it and documented Specimen.type as the standard replacement for the same concept code.
reconciliation: No FHIR core source was changed. The reconciliation is an external-repo audit because the only artifact originally created for the seed is outside the current core checkout and already reflects later final OO decisions in the Extension Pack.

related_jiras.note: Published FHIR Extension Pack decision to remove/retire observation-specimenCode because a referenced Specimen resource can represent just a code.
Published FHIR Extension Pack clarification adding replacement guidance that the same concept code can be communicated using Specimen.type.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification request to add an Observation specimenCode extension for code-only specimen identification when neither a Specimen resource nor precoordinated Observation.code is used.
evidence_items.learned: The original final work-group decision was to add an extension rather than change Observation.specimen to a code choice.
